operator_assessment.operator_summary: Publication scope is ELIGIBLE: 42 changed tournaments, none added or removed, all booked with calendar-matching intervals, none held or blocking. Season-wide planning debt is unchanged from the published baseline.

key_tradeoffs.title: Calendar-adopted intervals
key_tradeoffs.summary: Frisk Asker, Jar and Kongsberg intervals follow the club calendar blocks; Frisk Asker 0179 is 80 minutes, below the JU8 minimum.

remaining_actions.title: Season-wide planning debt
remaining_actions.summary: Participation shortfalls, 9 unplaced placements, hosting imbalances and Frisk Asker 0179 feasibility remain canonical maintenance work.

limitations: Semantic review used the bounded audit overview, the publication scope and the calendar audit, not every individual record.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 137 participation shortfalls and 123 club-pool shortfalls remain season-wide. No tournament was added or removed versus the published baseline (183 = 183), so this is pre-existing planning debt, not introduced by this export.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 9 unplaced tournament placements, 16 hosting-balance imbalances and 5 same-age hosting repairs, all unchanged from the published baseline. Hosting responsibility did not change in the 42-tournament delta.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: Durations 80-180 minutes, none missing, 0 blocking byes. Delta durations changed on Frisk Asker (mostly longer, 0179 shortened 120 to 80 min to the calendar block, below the JU8 minimum and recorded as a feasibility finding), Jar (1 to 10 min), Kongsberg and Jutul 0092 (-1 min). Every changed interval is a booked tournament whose accepted calendar interval equals the exported interval.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: All 37 interval-changed tournaments are booked with confirmed_matching calendar audit (calendar date/start/end equals export). Publication scope: 42 eligible, 0 proposed, 0 held, 0 blocking. 12 placements remain unverified for Frisk Asker and Sandefjord Penguins, unchanged pre-existing debt and outside the delta.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: No duplicate team-days (0), including the six tournaments with renamed JU8 teams.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: 14 tournaments with 3 teams from one club; none above the hard maximum of 3.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: CSV 2331 rows, overview 183, team counts 142, iCal 183, XLSX 183 all match the plan. Artifact parity PASS; an independent XLSX vs HTML comparison on date, start, end, arena, host, age group and team set found 0 mismatches.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification OK with 0 violations and 0 waivers. The delta is two JU8 team renames (Jar to Wildcats Turkis, Jutul Kittens to Wildcats Rosa on 6 tournaments) plus calendar-adopted interval changes and approval/booking labels moving to approved and confirmed_booked. No other material problem found.
